title: AI tool screens prostate needle biopsies and suggests ISUP grade groups
summary: An AI system trained on 2115 annotated whole-slide images was tested on an independent set of 150 prostate needle biopsy slides against pathologist-consensus ground truth. It identified all 109 malignant slides with no false negatives, whereas the pathologist consensus missed two, and it correctly classified 38 of 41 benign slides. The test set is small and retrospective.
